hook: They said 8 hours of perfect sleep every night was impossible. They were wrong.

script.visual: A close-up shot of a person looking exhausted, yawning at their desk late at night. The blue light from a laptop screen illuminates their tired face. A messy desk with coffee cups and papers.
script.audio: Sound of a deep yawn, quiet keyboard tapping, and a single notification ping.
script.text_overlay: You think this is just 'being tired'?

script.visual: Quick cuts: The person spills coffee in the morning. They look zoned-out during a video call. They're wide-eyed in bed, staring at the ceiling, unable to sleep.
script.audio: (Calm, confident Voiceover starts) "It's not. It's your body screaming for real rest. Not just closing your eyes, but deep, restorative sleep."
script.text_overlay: Your body is begging for this.

script.visual: The scene shifts dramatically. The person stands before the sleek, futuristic 'RestFlow Sleep Pod'. It's closed and glows with a soft, calming light. They reach out and touch the smooth surface with a sense of awe.
script.audio: (VO) "We've been using the same sleep technology for centuries. Until now." (A soft, futuristic humming sound fades in).
script.text_overlay: Welcome to the future of sleep.

script.visual: The pod door glides open silently. The person gets in, settling into the plush, ergonomic interior. The pod closes, and we see a subtle, pulsing light pattern on the exterior, visualizing a sleep cycle.
script.audio: (VO) "RestFlow uses personalized sonic waves and gentle temperature regulation to guide you into deep sleep cycles in minutes, not hours."

script.visual: The pod door opens with a soft morning light spilling in. The person emerges, but they look completely transformed. They are smiling, refreshed, and full of energy, taking a deep, satisfying stretch.
script.audio: Upbeat, inspiring music begins to swell. (VO) "So you don't just wake up. You're reborn. Every single morning."

script.visual: Final shot of the RestFlow Sleep Pod in a beautifully designed, minimalist bedroom, with the product name and logo clearly visible.
script.audio: (VO) "Stop surviving. Start thriving. Tap the link to get your RestFlow."

cta.caption_text: Ready to upgrade your life? Click the link in our bio to discover the RestFlow Sleep Pod. #SleepTech #FutureOfSleep #Biohacking #DeepSleep

tone: Aspirational, Relatable, and Soothing with a futuristic wonder.
